scope: Curated scalar/array evidence only. No raw logs/tensors/pickle, credentials, endpoints, balances or per-call/session identifiers. Prior slow-host measurements are retained with limits.

build_identity.actual_harness: acceptance.py (independent local orchestration, not a shipped example)

execution_scope.model_cold_definition: daemon had tiny file/generic smoke; no previous H3 weights or inference
execution_scope.script_clock_scope: client async workflow before Client/provenance, after Python imports; excludes provisioning, package/model installation and model download
execution_scope.block_boundary_scope: each two-image block starts with no next generation in flight; both first-image and total block costs include fill/drain boundaries

native_execution.inner_span_limit: nested wall/CPU spans overlap and must not be added together; process CPU includes all threads; only graph boundary includes the existing completion barrier

transfer.scope: Same ready IMAGE ref per host; actual HTTPS quick-tunnel/Caddy route. Raw captures disable auto-decompression. Entity bytes exclude HTTP/TLS/TCP framing. SDK fetch includes protocol decode and unpickle; raw capture time also includes hashing.

resource_observation.pressure_scope: paths are respectively /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.pressure and /proc/pressure/cpu; main-thread and single native worker schedstat are separately labeled in raw samples
resource_observation.gpu_peak_limit: not sampled during this clean run by design; Torch allocator counters in trace exclude some native allocations and are not GPU-board peaks
resource_observation.ram_limit: completed under the actual 111387082752-byte cgroup limit; observed sampled/HWM counters are not a minimum RAM requirement or hard-64GiB result

pipeline_comparison.interpretation: about 1.6% in these small samples; no demonstrated reliable throughput improvement

functional_scope.large_129MiB_cancel_persistence_model_ro: Passed on prior slow host only, not rerun here.

comparison_limits: Host CPU, driver, CPU visibility/quota, Torch defaults, memory limit, GPU power limit and external GPU observer changed together; the speed difference does not isolate a cause.
Old-host same-flags restart did not occur because GPU context release could not be established; no warm-cache same-host repeat is available.
Four different-seed images per mode in two blocks and three fetch samples per protocol are small samples; tiny pipeline differences do not establish an improvement.
HTTP entity byte counts exclude HTTP/TLS/TCP framing and are not physical wire bytes. JSON was gzip-compressed by the template route.

prior_slow_host.model_cold_scope: daemon had file/generic QA, but no earlier H3 weights or inference; measured setup is model-cold, not full daemon startup

transfer.scope: Same ready IMAGE ref per host; actual HTTPS quick-tunnel/Caddy route. Raw captures disable auto-decompression. Entity bytes exclude HTTP/TLS/TCP framing. SDK fetch includes protocol decode and unpickle; raw capture time also includes hashing.

resources.gpu_timestamp_limit: row timestamp precedes GPU query; elapsed/end were not recorded in first run. Successful NVML results can be seconds later than /proc values; GPU phase attribution is approximate and timed-out queries are missing samples.
resources.counter_limit: 2s sampler plus collection overhead; native allocations are not all included in Torch allocator counters; HWM may include earlier setup

same_flags_restart_attempt.reason: old worker gone, saved board GPU use 20284MiB and one bounded compute-apps query timed out; context release could not be established

prior_slow_host.network_scope: same existing official-template HTTPS quick tunnel via Caddy for public client fetch and file IO; entity bytes exclude HTTP/TLS/TCP framing and are not physical wire bytes

independent_native_analysis.scope: Offline independent analysis of sealed evidence; no further rental, inference or source change.
independent_native_analysis.causal_limit: Host, CPU visibility/quota/thread defaults, driver, GPU power, RAM limit and observer changed together. No causal attribution to NVML polling, thread count, CPU model, driver or power limit.
